# INV-USD-INC for 100.00 USD, its line booked to `Income:Sales USD`, paid from
# the CAD bank: `amount: 100` with `settled_amount: 137.00`.
#
# The posting is USD against USD, so nothing in it says what the USD cost in
# CAD. There is no cost to measure the settlement against, and nothing is
# realized.
#
# What this fixture produces: the invoice paid, the bank holding 137.00 CAD,
# no realized difference written, and no cost basis.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_usd_invoice_booked_to_usd_income_is_paid_from_a_cad_bank_realizing_nothing.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales USD
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-INC"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales USD"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-INC"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 137.00
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-INC"
